I replied to Hollis in a thread on his #central-random message: the ticket is **#88412**.

- **Where it came from:** Tobias raised it in #central-team on 2025-07-02 as a Tier 2 support escalation. The problem was the Door 6 gatehouse tablet freezing when scanning the barcode on the bill of lading. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so he can see this himself.
- **Which company:** In that thread the account was first written as "TP", which got mixed up with Tansley Parcel. Tobias then confirmed it was Tansleigh Packaging on #88412.
- **The ticket that looks similar:** Ticket #8841, mentioned in #central-random on 2026-10-13, is a different issue. It's about Door 2 double-booking on Tobias's dealer account, so I left it out.

Nothing here needed approval. A ticket number is an operational fact, and everyone in the channel is on the Central team.
